// 数据表的大小只与几何有关（与点数无关）；每个点由 hash 现算，不烘坐标

func setup() {
  let st_k = 0
  while (st_k < 343) {
    let st_ix = st_k % 7
    let st_iy = floor(st_k / 7) % 7
    let st_iz = floor(st_k / 49)
    let st_x = min(1, -1 + st_ix * 0.33333333 + (hash(0, st_k * 8 + 5) - 0.5) * 0.3)
    let st_y = min(1, -1 + st_iy * 0.33333333 + (hash(0, st_k * 8 + 6) - 0.5) * 0.3)
    let st_z = min(1, -1 + st_iz * 0.33333333 + (hash(0, st_k * 8 + 7) - 0.5) * 0.3)
    if ((abs(st_x) <= 1 && abs(st_y) <= 1 && abs(st_z) <= 1)) {
      let p = this.spawn({
        color: [1, 1, 1, 1],
        scale: 1,
        glow: false,
        light: 0,
        life: -1
      })
      p.position = [st_x, st_y, st_z]
    }
    st_k = st_k + 1
  }
}
